title: Determinism configuration: thinking off, temperature pinned, seed recorded

body.signal: Run-to-run output variance that contaminates paired comparisons.
body.failure_mode: Phase0 measured: thinking OFF at temp0 gave 10/10 byte-identical outputs; thinking OFF at temp1 with per-record seed gave 10/10; thinking ON with a pinned seed still gave 4 distinct outputs in 10 runs (A6).
body.detection: Any A/B comparison with model-driven variance in the treatment arm will under-detect or fake effects; check the config block on every rollout record before interpreting deltas.
body.fix_strategy: For benchmark and replay runs: thinking OFF, temperature 0 or 1-with-seed, per-record seed = sha256(run_id|case_id|generation|candidate_index) recorded in every rollout record.

provenance.source: phase0/runs/FINAL_REPORT.md section 'Setup measured facts' (Stage A, A4-A6)
provenance.note: Seeded from hand-authored/analyzed artifacts; promoted by human decision, not agent replay.

counterfactual.evidence: N/A for seeds - promoted by human authorship at engine bootstrap.
